title: Answer: the information physics gives is structural and leaves intrinsic nature open

statements.text: The view makes no claim that information is basic. The information physics supplies is structural, about what entities do, and it leaves open what they are. Newman’s problem adds that a purely formal description is near vacuous unless it includes a non-formal notion.

sources.quote: physics leaves open all kinds of possibilities as to the intrinsic character of the world to which its equations apply
The essence of the problem is that any purely formal description of the physical world is near vacuous.
